_README: Transcription fixes for your talking-head videos. Applied ONCE to the canonical transcript (outputs/<job>.transcript.json) when rough-cut splices it, so the fix flows to graphics AND captions AND every format — not just burned-in captions. The raw transcript/words.json is left untouched. 'auto' = whole-word, case-insensitive replacements applied silently, matched ONE WORD AT A TIME — keys must be single-token (a multi-word key like 'open ai' can never match). 'flag' = ambiguous words (real word OR a mishear) PRINTED for you to eyeball in context each run. For a one-off fix on a single video, drop a corrections.local.json (same {auto,flag} shape) in that job folder. ADD YOUR OWN brand/product names here (and to brand-kit.md) — WhisperX mishears them. The entries below are generic casing fixes most creators want.
